chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Ziyad ibn Suqah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no problem if one of you were to pray in the one cloth and his loin cloth is loose. The Religion of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is faultless.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in a single piece of clothing with a loose lower garment?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) validates the flexibility of prayer attire, specifically allowing a single garment with a loosened loin cloth, by grounding the ruling in the concept of 'Hanifiyyah'—the natural, unburdened disposition of Islam. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on ease (yusr) and the removal of unnecessary rigidity in worship, distinguishing it from later juristic debates on the minimum coverage (awrah) required for validity.
